summary: The treatment and control arms match. The revised preprint reports 7,347 fructose-arm gene-by-population results, each specific to a cell type or neuronal subtype. HypoExplorer estimates one effect across all captured cells per library, so agreement remains unassessed. I proposed partial availability and a not_comparable outcome after verifying 58 saved source files. [Author supplement](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2022.09.06.506855v2.supplementary-material)
openIssues: Reassessment would require an author gene-level result for Akkermansia versus PBS across all captured cells in the fructose-arm libraries, with documented cell inclusion.
The authors report three mice per group. The public sources reviewed did not identify each library’s mouse and cage or the barcodes retained after author QC.
